p02-post-1.text: 12 hour shift done. Three codes in one night. Going to sleep for a year.

p02-post-2.text: Shoutout to the night crew, honestly the best team I've worked with

p02-post-3.text: Breakfast for dinner again since my schedule is upside down

p02-post-4.text: Mandatory overtime announced with two hours notice. Love that for us.

p02-post-5.text: Biscuit learned to sit on command!! Proudest dog mom moment

p02-post-6.text: Reminder that flu shots are free at the county clinic this week

p02-post-7.text: Mom's 60th was perfect. Whole family in one room for once

p02-post-8.text: My back is wrecked from lifting patients all night

p02-post-9.text: Studying for my critical care certification on days off

p02-post-10.text: Binged the whole season of The Pitt in two days. Painfully accurate.

p02-post-11.text: Someone dinged my car in the hospital lot and drove off

p02-post-12.text: First 5k since knee surgery. Slow but I finished!

p02-post-13.text: Switching to days in July. Not sure how my body will cope

p02-post-14.text: Patient's daughter brought the whole unit cookies today. Made my week.

p02-post-15.text: Living in Chicago eight years and I still can't handle the winters

p02-post-16.text: Sick with the same cold my whole floor had. Shocking.

p02-post-18.text: Anyone know if the hospital daycare has openings?

p02-post-19.text: Another round of staffing cuts in the state budget. Unbelievable.

p02-post-20.text: Came home to Biscuit asleep on my scrubs. Best welcome.
